CustomField.description: 105: PRIORITY_PASSIVE - No extra power will be used to derive locations. 104: PRIORITY_LOW_POWER - Low power usage at the possible expense of location accuracy. 102: PRIORITY_BALANCED_POWER_ACCURACY - Balanced between location accuracy and power usage. 100: PRIORITY_HIGH_ACCURACY - Highly accurate locations at the possible expense of additional power usage.
